name: pmjob-questions-to-ask
description: Writes your Questions to Ask Interviewers, a set for each interviewer by role across the work, the team, how decisions get made and what a good first year looks like, with anything the website already answers removed and three marked to ask first. Use for "run pmjob-questions-to-ask", "questions to ask at the end of an interview", "do you have any questions for us", "what should I ask the hiring manager", "questions for a product interview panel", "smart questions for the final round", "what to ask the recruiter", part of the Claude Guide for Product Interviews Pack by 90n.
